verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents an Entitlements feature in which Features are allocated as customer privileges based on the products a customer subscribes to, so the modeling half of the story is covered. The evidence never shows an entitlements API endpoint or SDK method for checking a customer's entitlements at runtime; the general REST API and SDKs are not shown to cover entitlements. missing for 10: documented runtime entitlement-check API/SDK endpoint, explicit limit/quantity modeling details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, features and limits are modeled as entitlements attached to plans, and my application can check a customer's entitlements at runtime via API or SDK

citations.quote: entitlements refer to the system of providing a suite of features, which different customers have access to based on the products they have subscribed to.
Chargebee provides you an efficient UI to allocate and manage the customer privileges using Features.
Let Chargebee AI draft product families, plans, addons, charges, prices, features, and entitlements from a pricing page, document, or description.
